candidate.answerReason: Rides cost 24 dollars, so Susan has 50-12-24=14 dollars left.

methods.label: Find and subtract both expenses
methods.explanation:
Twice the \(12\) dollars spent on food is \(2\cdot12=24\) dollars spent on rides. Subtract both expenses from Susan's \(50\) dollars:
\[
50-12-24=14.
\]
She has \(\boxed{14}\) dollars left, choice \(\text{B}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses only doubling and whole-number subtraction.
